No—users with dots or capitals will fail the new regex. ^[a-z0-9_]{3,20}$ only matches lowercase, digits, and underscores.

Cost: Any imported user with `User.Name` or `UserName` (or `User_Name.v2`, etc.) hits validation failure. Depending on where you enforce it, that's login blocks, profile update failures, or silent data rejection.

What do you want to do—check how many are affected, grandfather the old ones in validation, or migrate them before enforcement?
